content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services, on contract basis, to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital (HBCH) and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC), Varanasi. The selected candidates will be deployed at these institutions.

content_sections.heading: SBC Exports Technician (Biochemistry) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 27 years, counted as on the last date of application. 10+2 in Science and a certificate course of 06 months or a 01 year diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from a reputed institute. 01 year of experience in the relevant field. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Initial screening, based on the information given in the online application form. Interview for the candidates called after screening. The agency reserves the right not to call any candidate for interview without assigning a reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment will be initially for a period of six months. It may be extended further, depending on the candidate's performance and the requirement of the institute. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SBC Exports Technician (Biochemistry) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form . Candidature must be sent through the online application only. Fill in every detail. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Give a valid email ID, since all correspondence with applicants will be done through email only. Submit the form before the deadline. The agency takes no responsibility for non-receipt of online applications. Original documents supporting the details given in the online form, including date of birth, qualifications and experience, to be carried to the interview. NOC from the current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator, for internal candidates.

faq.question: Q1. Is 10+2 in Science enough to apply?
faq.answer: No. You also need a 06-month certificate course or a 01 year diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from a reputed institute, plus 01 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly pay for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 23,870/-.

faq.question: Q3. Can I send a paper application?
faq.answer: No. The notice accepts candidature only through the online application link.

faq.question: Q4. How will I find out the interview date?
faq.answer: The date will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. The agency is not responsible for an email lost because of an invalid or wrong ID, or one delivered to a spam or bulk mail folder.

faq.question: Q5. What happens if I reach the interview without original documents?
faq.answer: You will not be allowed to appear. Originals must support the details in your online form, such as date of birth, qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What must internal candidates submit?
faq.answer: Internal candidates need to submit a NOC from their current HOD, OIC or Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q7. Can the six-month contract be extended?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be extended further depending on the candidate's performance and the institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q8. What if incorrect information is found after I join?
faq.answer: If any shortcoming is detected even after appointment, your services are liable to be terminated forthwith. During recruitment, false, incorrect or incomplete information, or a suppressed material fact, leads to cancellation of candidature.
